trials.claim: Create branded cookie banners, auto-scan cookies, generate legal policies, and log consent decisions
trials.claimQuote: Create branded cookie banners, auto-scan cookies, generate legal policies, and log consent decisions
trials.reasoning: Users report cookie scans repeatedly failing to complete and generated legal text containing raw '[object Object]' code errors. These failures materially undercut the claimed auto-scan and policy-generation features, despite the vendor listing them.

exhibits.quote: After numerous attempts to scan the cookies, it still does not work, a couple of attempts are reamastall day in the queue
exhibits.argument: Quote shows auto-scan feature repeatedly fails to complete, contradicting claim of reliable auto-scan cookies.

exhibits.quote: We offer a [object Object]-day free trial" appears three times - a raw code error that made it into the legal text.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows policy generator outputs broken code-filled legal text, undermining claim it generates usable legal policies.

exhibits.quote: Everything you need for GDPR/CCPA/PIPEDA compliance: banners, consent logs, cookie scanning, and policy generators in one single tool
exhibits.argument: Vendor homepage lists the four core capabilities together as one tool, matching the claim.
Pricing page confirms consent logging is included in all plans.

trials.claim: Launch a fully brand-matched cookie banner in a few clicks
trials.claimQuote: Launch a fully brand-matched cookie banner in a few clicks
trials.reasoning: Users call the tool very difficult compared to competitors and report the banner reappearing on every page load after acceptance. This conflicts with launching a working brand-matched banner in a few clicks.

exhibits.quote: it works but it's confusing. very difficult compared to other cookie/privacy policy tools.
exhibits.argument: Quote directly contradicts few-clicks ease by calling setup very difficult versus competitors.

exhibits.quote: The software feels unfinished. A basic feature isn’t working: the cookie banner shows up on EVERY page load, even after accepting.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows banner fails to launch and persist correctly, undermining claim of quick successful launch.

exhibits.quote: It streamlines compliance by automatically scanning and identifying trackers, generating brand-matched cookie banners, and ensuring banners meet IAB TCF 2.3 and Google Consent Mode v2 requirements.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes generating brand-matched cookie banners as part of streamlined compliance.

exhibits.quote: Quickly create GDPR, CCPA, and privacy policies or terms and conditions tailored to your business with just a few clicks.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states core setup can be done in just a few clicks, supporting ease of launch.

trials.claim: Seller offers full control over banner layouts, colors, fonts, and copy
trials.claimQuote: Match your site’s look with full control over layouts, colors, fonts, and copy
trials.reasoning: Users report saved banner options not persisting and configured language/copy still showing in English on the live site. This shows the claimed full control over banner appearance and copy does not reliably apply.

exhibits.quote: In the backend the saved option has not saved
exhibits.argument: Quote shows customization choices do not persist, contradicting claim of full control over banner appearance.

exhibits.quote: Have configured a banner in our language, in the backend everything looks fine, but on frontend the banner is still in English.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows language/copy control fails to apply on live banner, undermining full control over copy.
Vendor lists multiple layouts as included banner customization.
Vendor explicitly offers full control over colors and fonts for the banner.
